self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: R5 Mind in Bloom: triggering Electro-Charged, Lunar-Charged, Bloom, Lunar-Bloom, Crystallize, or Lunar-Crystallize grants Elemental Mastery +120 for 15s (once per 15s, works off-field); Energy Recharge restoration not modeled.

en.flavor: Tribal tales tell of a great blade forged by the People of the Springs to protect a child who would embark on a distant journey. This particular weapon appears to be a replica of that legendary sword.

refinements.1: When Electro-Charged, Lunar-Charged, Bloom, Lunar-Bloom, Crystallize or Lunar-Crystallize is triggered, restore <r>12</r> Elemental Energy and increase Elemental Mastery by <r>60</r> for 15 seconds. This effect can be triggered at most once every 15s and can be triggered even when the equipping character is off-field.
refinements.2: When Electro-Charged, Lunar-Charged, Bloom, Lunar-Bloom, Crystallize or Lunar-Crystallize is triggered, restore <r>15</r> Elemental Energy and increase Elemental Mastery by <r>75</r> for 15 seconds. This effect can be triggered at most once every 15s and can be triggered even when the equipping character is off-field.

This effect can be triggered at most once every 15s and can be triggered even when the equipping character is off-field.
refinements.4: When Electro-Charged, Lunar-Charged, Bloom, Lunar-Bloom, Crystallize or Lunar-Crystallize is triggered, restore <r>21</r> Elemental Energy and increase Elemental Mastery by <r>105</r> for 15 seconds. This effect can be triggered at most once every 15s and can be triggered even when the equipping character is off-field.
refinements.5: When Electro-Charged, Lunar-Charged, Bloom, Lunar-Bloom, Crystallize or Lunar-Crystallize is triggered, restore <r>24</r> Elemental Energy and increase Elemental Mastery by <r>120</r> for 15 seconds. fr.flavor: Les légendes tribales parlent d'une grande lame forgée par le Peuple des sources pour protéger un enfant qui s'apprêtait à entreprendre un voyage lointain. Cette arme semble être une réplique de cette épée légendaire.
